# get_isotherms_dict_for_multiple_raspa_folders { #mofography.raspa_helper.get_isotherms_dict_for_multiple_raspa_folders }

```python
raspa_helper.get_isotherms_dict_for_multiple_raspa_folders(list_of_folder_paths)
```

Build a dict of isotherm DataFrames keyed by folder basename for each run folder.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                 | Type   | Description                                                    | Default    |
|----------------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| list_of_folder_paths |        | list of paths to the folders containing the raspa output files | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                         |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------|
|        |        | a dictionary with the isotherm data |
